docs/catalog/ve-direct.md — existing entry `victron-ble-instant-readout`, which establishes the container, the key handling and the model-binding gap from the same PDF for record 0x01. Not re-derived here.
https://communityarchive.victronenergy.com/questions/187303/victron-bluetooth-advertising-protocol.html — the Victron staff post releasing the format, already cited by the existing entry.

transport: BLE advertisement, no connection and no pairing session needed to read — but see gotchas, a per-device AES key is needed to decrypt. Victron manufacturer data, byte 3 = 0x10 (Product Advertisement). Extra-manufacturer-data record starts at byte 8. Header: bits 0–7 record type (0x02 here), bits 8–23 nonce/data counter LSB-first, bits 24–31 byte 0 of the encryption key. Payload AES-CTR, 2-byte heade
blocks: Record type 0x02, Battery Monitor. Bit offsets from the start of the record, transcribed from the committed PDF: 32/16 TTG, 1 min, range 0..45.5 days, NA 0xFFFF (VE_REG_TTG) · 48/16 Battery voltage, 0.01 V, -327.68..327.66 V, NA 0x7FFF (VE_REG_DC_CHANNEL1_VOLTAGE) · 64/16 Alarm reason, 0..0xFFFF, no NA (VE_REG_ALARM_REASON) · 80/16 selector-dependent: Aux voltage 0.01 V -327.68..327.64 V (VE_REG_DC_CHANNEL2_VOLTAGE) or Mid voltage 0.01 V 0..655.34 V (VE_REG_BATTERY_MID_POINT_VOLTAGE) or Temperature 0.01 K 0..655.34 K (VE_REG_BAT_TEMPERATURE), no NA · 96/2 Aux input selector, NA 0x3, values 0 aux voltage, 1 mid voltage, 2 temperature, 3 none (VE_REG_BMV_AUX_INPUT) · 98/22 Battery current, 0.001 A, -4194..4194 A, NA 0x3FFFFF (VE_REG_DC_CHANNEL1_CURRENT_MA) · 120/20 Consumed Ah, 0.1 Ah, -104857..0 Ah, NA 0xFFFFF (VE_REG_CAH) · 140/10 SOC, 0.1 %, 0..100.0 %, NA 0x3FF (VE_REG_SOC) · 150/10 unused.

gotchas: Which models emit record 0x02 is `unverified`, and the models list is deliberately empty. The committed specification names zero product models anywhere — it is a device-category spec keyed by record type. docs/catalog/ve-direct.md reached the same conclusion for record 0x01 and it holds here. The plausible emitters ar

Consumed Ah is sign-inverted. The vendor's own remark, verbatim: "Consumed Ah = -Record value". The field's stated range is -104,857..0 Ah while the raw is unsigned 20-bit. Read it straight and every discharge reads as a charge.

Bits 80–95 have three different meanings and you cannot tell which without bits 96–97. Aux voltage (0.01 V, signed), mid-point voltage (0.01 V, unsigned) and battery temperature (0.01 K) share one 16-bit slot, selected by the 2-bit Aux input field that sits *after* it. Temperature here is Kelvin at 0.01 scale. The MPPT HEX register 0xEDEC is also Kelvin-at-0.01 with 0xFFFF meaning N/A; this field has no NA value listed. Do not decode a sentinel as 655.35 K, and do not forget the 273.15 offset.

SOC here is 0.1 %, while the same quantity over the VE.Direct cable is ‰. Two transports, two scales, same device. Read the scale from the transport, never from the register name — the same warning docs/catalog/ve-direct.md records for PV power across three encodings.
unmappedReports: Alarm reason at bit 64, 16 bits (VE_REG_ALARM_REASON) — the same bitfield as text-mode AR, including low SOC, low/high starter voltage, mid voltage, short circuit and BMS lockout. No fault/alarm-code MetricKind., Aux input selector at bits 96–97 (VE_REG_BMV_AUX_INPUT) — not a measurement, but without it bits 80–95 cannot be interpreted at all. There is no contract slot for "what this channel is currently configured to measure"., Aux voltage (VE_REG_DC_CHANNEL2_VOLTAGE) — no second-DC-channel voltage metric., Mid-point voltage (VE_REG_BATTERY_MID_POINT_VOLTAGE) — no metric. Unlike text mode there is no mid-point *deviation* field here either, so the derived quantity has to be computed from bank voltage.
